title_tag: 8 Best Budapest Airport Hotels (2026): Shuttle & Price
meta_description: Budapest airport hotels compared: walk to Terminal 2 or take the shuttle, free parking, early check-out and price per night from €50 to €145.
author_role: 8 airport hotels compared on distance to Terminal 2, shuttle, parking, check-in hours and price
lead: The right airport hotel in Budapest depends on your flight: a well-rated hotel with its own minibus for €80 (that is Airport Hotel Budapest, the #1 pick), a room you can walk to from Terminal 2 for a 6 am flight, a spa night before a long-haul, or the cheapest bed with free parking if you are driving. Going into town instead? See Budapest airport to the city centre. This page gets you to the right room in under a minute.

To make the choice easy, I compared all 8 on what decides an airport night: distance to the terminal, whether a shuttle is listed (and if it is free), parking, check-in and check-out hours, guest scores and the price for the same night, checked on each hotel's own listing. Filter by terminal, shuttle, free parking or price below, or scroll straight to the ranking.

guide.h2: Budapest Airport Hotels Side by Side
guide.html:

What the numbers say: being at the terminal costs about €50–65 more than staying a shuttle ride away. ibis Styles and TRIBE (€131–145) are the only two you can walk to from Terminal 2; Airport Hotel Budapest is 1.6 miles out with its own minibus and costs €80, with a higher score than ibis. If you have a car, A22 in Gyál (€50, free parking) has the best value score here (9.3).

• Most flights: #1 Airport Hotel Budapest, minibus included in the plan.
  • Very early flight, no shuttle stress: #2 ibis Styles or #3 TRIBE, both at Terminal 2.
  • A proper rest before a long-haul: #4 Stáció with its spa.
  • Driving and on a budget: #5 A22 Gyál.
  • Long-term parking while you fly: #7 Ferihegy.
  • Halfway to town: #8 Allora in Kispest.

Spending more nights in the city? Compare the best hotels in Budapest or where to stay.

guide.h2: Before You Book: Check-in Windows and Shuttles
guide.html:
Late arrivals: A22 Hotel Gyál only checks guests in from 4 pm to 8:30 pm, so it does not suit a midnight landing. TRIBE checks in until midnight; most others have a 24-hour front desk.

Shuttles: ibis Styles and Stáció list the airport shuttle as free. Ferihegy charges for transfers and Allora's shuttle is paid; book them when you book the room.

Early breakfast: Ferihegy serves breakfast from 7 to 10 am; Airport Hotel Budapest's restaurant opens at 6 am.

Parking while you travel: Ferihegy offers long-term parking for an extra fee.

faqs.q: Which hotel is closest to Budapest airport?
faqs.a: ibis Styles Budapest Airport and TRIBE Budapest Airport are both at Terminal 2, about 0.2 miles from the terminal, so you can walk.

faqs.q: Which Budapest airport hotels have a free shuttle?
faqs.a: ibis Styles Budapest Airport and Budapest Airport Hotel Stáció list a free airport shuttle. Airport Hotel Budapest runs its own minibus, about 2 minutes to the airport.

faqs.q: What is the cheapest hotel near Budapest airport?
faqs.a: A22 Hotel Gyál at €50 for two on a March weeknight, with free parking but no listed shuttle; Hotel Ferihegy at €57 offers transfers for a fee.

faqs.q: Can I leave my car at a hotel near Budapest airport?
faqs.a: Hotel Ferihegy offers long-term parking for an extra fee. Airport Hotel Budapest, Eprespark and A22 list free parking during your stay.

faqs.q: Is there an airport hotel with a spa in Budapest?
faqs.a: Budapest Airport Hotel Stáció Wellness has a spa with a hot tub, about 5 minutes from the airport, with a free shuttle.

methodology: We compared hotels within 4 miles of Budapest Ferenc Liszt International Airport on what decides an airport night: distance to Terminal 2, shuttle and its cost, parking, check-in and check-out hours, guest scores and the price for the same night (10 March 2027, 2 adults), all from each hotel's live listing.
